pages.text: $(#D4AF37)🏮 Fate Forged in Gold · Eternal Blessing 🪔$()$(br2)$(l)$(#FFD700)「Those who drink this golden nectar shall forever bask in the light of fortune」$()$(br)The solar essence of $(#DAA520)Golden Carrot$(), the radiant glow of $(#FF8C00)Molten Gold Melon$(), the millennium-old wish of $(#B8860B)Dried Marigold$(), and the divine purity of $(#D4AF37)God-Forged Gold Ingot$() merge in the sacred flames of the $(#8B4513)Holy Furnace$()—thus forming the ultimate alchemical masterpiece capable of $(l)winning the favor of the Goddess of Fortune$().

$(#FFD700)▌ Eternal Destiny $()$(br2)$(l)$(#32CD32)🍀 Four-Leaf Inscription$()$(br)Emerald-colored $(#7CFC00)fate markings$() appear on the skin.$(br2)$(l)$(#FFD700)✨ Gold Vein Resonance$()$(br)Each movement triggers $(#DAA520)golden particle$() blessings.$(br2)$(l)$(#8B4513)⚖ Causal Shift$()$(br)All probability-based events lean toward the $(#FF8C00)most favorable outcome$().

$(br2)$(#B8860B)▌ Ritual of Transmutation $()$(br)- Use a $(#D4AF37)purified golden blade$() to cut $(#DAA520)Golden Carrots$() into a $(#FFD700)dodecahedron$().$(br)- Mash $(#FF8C00)melon flesh$() in a $(#8B4513)white stone mortar$() until it reaches a $(#CD853F)liquid amber$() state.$(br)- $(#B8860B)Dried Marigold$() must be sun-dried under $(#FFD700)noon sunlight$() for exactly $(#D4AF37)three quarters of an hour$().$(br)- When adding the $(#D4AF37)Gold Ingot$(), simultaneously complete the $(#32CD32)Seven-Point Star Array$().$(br2)$(#FF4500)※$() When a $(#FFD700)solar emblem$() appears on the soup’s surface and emits a $(#7CFC00)jade-green glow$(), the brew is complete.

$(br2)$(#8B4513)『 The Midas Codex 』$()$(br)An inscription from the ancient Golden Empire records:$(br)'Only those who consume this $(#D4AF37)solidified sunrise$(),$(br)shall receive the $(#FFD700)Touch of Gold$()—$(br)their $(#32CD32)every decision$() shall lead to $(#7CFC00)prosperity$(),$(br)even the $(#B8860B)Threads of Fate$() spun by the $(#8B4513)Three Sisters$()$(br)shall weave themselves willingly around their $(#DAA520)fingertips$().'
